# rust-wasm fixture

Real wasm-bindgen output, generated by `scripts/toolchains/make-rust-wasm-fixture.sh`; do not
edit by hand. It is the Rust web lane's output shape (`index.html`, `game.js`,
`game_bg.wasm`) for the small crate in `crate/`: no wgpu, it answers the Rust web shell's
page contract (`studio_boot`, `studio_call`, `studio_frame`) with a frame counter. The
`rust-game` fixture's stub toolchain serves these bytes for a web build
(`src/main/dev/fixture-rust.ts`).

- Compiler: `rustc 1.99.0 (b940084d7 2026-09-28)`, target `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, release, offline and locked
  against the vendored crates (`crate/Cargo.lock`).
- Bindings: `wasm-bindgen 0.2.129 --target web --no-typescript --out-name game`.
- Shell: `src/game-template-rust/web/shell.html`, the Rust template's, as `index.html`.
- Template shell sha256: `5202511fa6e84f2fd8a4462ddec1be80701e989cd7ef21d81fb22c6a5addf854` (`--check` refuses a fixture built from another).
- Byte-reproducible: yes: two builds, each from its own fresh target folder, gave the same bytes for every file.
- Check: `scripts/toolchains/make-rust-wasm-fixture.sh --check` compares the shell above,
  then rebuilds into a scratch folder and compares these digests.
